atoms.b: The Picts from Scotland, the Scots from Ireland and the Saxons from Northern Europe had been ((++raiding helping)) Britain for years.
Without the ((++Roman Egyptian)) army, the Britons struggled to defend themselves all on their own.

feedback.finish: Eventually, a king of the Britons asked the Saxons to help defend Britain. In exchange, the Saxons were allowed to settle in the South-East.

atoms.b: We need help! The Picts and Scots keep ((++invading sending_sheep)). Come to our aid. Let us fight them together.
We could... but what’s in it for us?
I will let you build ((++villages skyscrapers)) in the South-East, and I will pay you handsomely.
You have a deal! I will bring my army, and we will crush the ((++Picts_and_Scots Britons)).
atoms.sound: You have a deal! Eye will bring my army, and we will crush the Picts and Scots.

instruction.text: It wasn’t long before the Saxons decided they wanted more from their deal. Select the two things they might have wanted.

atoms.b: When the Britons refused, the Saxons began to ((++attack dance)). At the same time, the Saxons were joined by two other Germanic tribes called the ((++Angles Britons)) and the Jutes.
The Britons were made up of many small ((++tribes castles)), so they struggled to defend against this unified ((++Germanic Italian)) attack.
